description: Transform addcn from a local dev tool into a multi-user registry platform with namespaced URLs, authentication, organizations, and component sharing, no fallbacks this's should be like a new project production ready no fallbacks

userStories.title: Create Convex schema with all tables
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the database schema defined for users, organizations, members, invites, and components.
acceptanceCriteria: Create convex/schema.ts with users table (username, email, avatarUrl, externalId, createdAt)
Add organizations table (name, slug, avatarUrl, createdAt) with by_slug index
Add orgMembers table (orgId, userId, role, invitedBy, joinedAt) with indexes
Add invites table (orgId, email, role, invitedBy, token, expiresAt, createdAt) with indexes
Update components table with userId, orgId, createdBy, isPublic, downloads fields
userStories.notes: Schema created. componentFileValidator already existed in validators.ts.

userStories.notes: Created validation.ts with RESERVED_NAMES, isValidUsername (validates length, charset, no consecutive hyphens, no start/end hyphen, reserved names), and isValidOrgSlug alias.

userStories.notes: Created permissions.ts with canAccessComponent (checks public, owner, org member), canEditComponent (owner or admin), canPublishComponent (alias), and canTransferComponent (returns object with allowed + reason).
